articles.title: Mitigating Over-Personalization in LLMs via Structured Memory
articles.abstract: Conversational assistants increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory to personalize responses across sessions. However, when stored user information is reintroduced into the model context, it can also influence responses in inappropriate or unrelated settings. We study two such failure modes in memory-augmented LLMs: cross-domain leakage, where memories from one life domain affect responses in another, and memory-induced sycophancy, where stored user beliefs make models more likely to agree with the user rather than respond truthfully. We apply a simple inference-time modification to how memories are presented to the model, without changing the model or the memory contents. Across seven models on PersistBench, we compare the commonly used all-in context format, where memories are injected as an unstructured list, with structured formats that partition memories by domain. This simple modification consistently reduces cross-domain leakage while preserving utility, with our strongest method reducing leakage by $8.8\%$ on average relative to the baseline.
articles.titleCn: 通过结构化记忆减轻大语言模型的过度个性化
articles.abstractCn: 对话助手越来越依赖持久长期记忆来跨会话个性化回复。然而，当存储的用户信息重新引入模型上下文中时，它也可能在不适当或不相关的场景中影响回复。我们研究了记忆增强大型语言模型中的两种此类失效模式：跨域泄露，即一个生活领域中的记忆会影响另一个领域的回复；以及记忆诱导的谄媚，即存储的用户信念使模型更倾向于同意用户而非如实回复。我们应用了一种简单的推理时修改方法，来改变记忆呈现给模型的方式，而无需更改模型或记忆内容。在PersistBench上的七个模型中，我们比较了通常使用的全上下文格式（将记忆注入为非结构化列表）与按领域划分记忆的结构化格式。这种简单的修改始终能减少跨域泄露，同时保持效用，我们最强的方法相对于基线平均减少了8.8%的泄露。

articles.title: Do Evaluation Metrics Detect Errors in Classical Chinese to English Translations?
articles.abstract: Although large language models can translate some historical languages surprisingly well, their usefulness in digital humanities workflows is limited by the lack of reliable evaluation. We investigate whether existing automatic evaluation metrics developed for modern languages are reliable in this setting, using translation from Classical Chinese to English as a test case. We introduce a diagnostic framework based on minimal pairs capturing error types salient in scholarly use, probing both reference-based and reference-free metrics for error sensitivity and tolerance to valid variation. We find that all metrics exhibit blind spots, however MetricX24 performs best overall. Our findings highlight the need for more robust and interpretable metrics for historically and culturally distinct translation settings.
articles.titleCn: 评估指标能否检测古汉语到英语翻译中的错误？
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型在翻译某些历史语言方面表现出惊人的效果，但它们在数字人文工作流程中的实用性因缺乏可靠的评估而受到限制。我们研究了现有为现代语言开发的自动评估指标在这一场景下的可靠性，并以从古汉语翻译成英语作为测试案例。我们引入了一个基于最小对的诊断框架，捕捉学术使用中突出的错误类型，同时测试基于参考和非基于参考的指标在错误敏感性和对有效变异的容忍度方面的表现。我们发现所有指标都存在盲点，但MetricX24总体表现最佳。我们的研究强调了为具有历史和文化差异的翻译场景开发更稳健和可解释的指标的需求。

articles.title: AraSSM: A bidirectional state-space encoder for Arabic masked language modeling
articles.abstract: Pretrained Transformer encoders such as AraBERT, MARBERT, and CAMeLBERT have become the standard backbone for Arabic natural language understanding, but their self-attention mechanism scales quadratically with sequence length, which limits efficiency on long documents. Mamba, a selective state-space model (SSM), offers linear-time sequence modeling as a competitive alternative to attention, yet no dedicated bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained specifically for Arabic currently exists. We introduce AraSSM, a bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained via masked language modeling on a corpus combining Arabic Wikipedia and CulturaX text, trained end-to-end on four consumer-grade NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPUs (11GB) over approximately ten days. We evaluate AraSSM by fine-tuning on four established Arabic NLU benchmarks covering sentiment classification (HARD), named entity recognition (ANERcorp), extractive question answering (ARCD), and natural language inference (XNLI-ar), following the per-task evaluation protocol introduced by AraBERT, and report results as mean +/- standard deviation across three fine-tuning seeds. AraSSM matches or exceeds published base-sized Transformer baselines on sentiment classification (96.37 +/- 0.03% accuracy on HARD), is competitive on extractive QA (32.19 +/- 1.07 EM, 63.79 +/- 0.25 F1 on ARCD) and named entity recognition (81.54 +/- 0.30 entity-level F1 on ANERcorp), and trails the base-sized Transformer range on natural language inference (72.83 +/- 0.07% accuracy on XNLI-ar), despite being trained entirely from scratch on consumer hardware rather than large-scale accelerator clusters.
articles.titleCn: AraSSM：一种用于阿拉伯语掩码语言模型的双向状态空间编码器
articles.abstractCn: 预训练的Transformer编码器，如AraBERT、MARBERT和CAMeLBERT，已成为阿拉伯自然语言理解的标准骨干，但它们的自注意力机制随序列长度呈平方级扩展，这限制了在长文档上的效率。Mamba是一种选择性状态空间模型（SSM），以线性时间序列建模作为注意力机制的竞争性替代方案，但目前还没有专门为阿拉伯语预训练的双向Mamba编码器。我们介绍了AraSSM，这是一个通过掩码语言模型在结合阿拉伯语维基百科和CulturaX文本语料库上预训练的双向Mamba编码器，在四块消费级NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPU（每块11GB）上端到端训练了约十天。我们通过在四个成熟的阿拉伯语NLU基准数据集上进行微调来评估AraSSM，这些基准数据集涵盖了情感分类（HARD）、命名实体识别（ANERcorp）、抽取式问答（ARCD）和自然语言推理（XNLI-ar），遵循AraBERT引入的按任务评估协议，并报告了在三个微调种子下的结果，以平均值±标准差的形式呈现。AraSSM在情感分类（在HARD上达到96.37±0.03%的准确率）上达到了或超过了已发表的基线Transformer模型，在抽取式问答（在ARCD上达到32.19±1.07 EM，63.79±0.25 F1）和命名实体识别（在ANERcorp上达到81.54±0.30的实体级F1）上具有竞争力，但在自然语言推理（在XNLI-ar上达到72.83±0.07%的准确率）上落后于基线Transformer模型，尽管它完全在消费级硬件上从头开始训练，而不是在大型加速器集群上训练。

articles.title: Learning from Environmental Feedback: Credit Assignment across Multiple Timescales for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often suffers from delayed and sparse rewards in real-world environments. A promising solution to this challenge is credit assignment, which aims to decompose trajectory-level rewards and provide more fine-grained supervision for intermediate decisions. However, existing credit assignment approaches ignore the rich process information naturally generated during environment interaction, e.g., interaction history. We argue that such information provides valuable supervision for identifying the contribution of individual actions. To this end, we propose Environmental Feedback-based Credit Assignment (EFCA), a multi-timescale credit assignment approach for long-horizon agentic RL. EFCA complements the long-term outcome signal with two environment-grounded process signals: a short-term feedback signal that captures the immediate effect of the current action and a medium-term state-history signal that identifies ineffective patterns from recent interactions. Both signals are directly extracted from environment feedback and integrated through a return reweighting mechanism. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that EFCA consistently improves both task success and task quality over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of environment-grounded multi-timescale credit assignment for long-horizon agentic RL.
articles.titleCn: 从环境反馈中学习：多时间尺度下的信用分配，用于自主强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 在现实世界环境中，具身强化学习（RL）经常受到延迟和稀疏奖励的影响。解决这一挑战的一个有前景的方案是归因分配，其旨在分解轨迹级奖励，并为中间决策提供更细粒度的指导。然而，现有的归因分配方法忽略了在环境交互过程中自然生成的丰富过程信息，例如交互历史。我们认为此类信息为识别单个动作的贡献提供了宝贵的指导。为此，我们提出了基于环境反馈的归因分配（EFCA），这是一种用于长时程具身RL的多时间尺度归因分配方法。EFCA通过两个基于环境的进程信号补充长期结果信号：一个短期反馈信号，用于捕获当前动作的即时效果；一个中期状态-历史信号，用于从最近的交互中识别无效模式。这两个信号都直接从环境反馈中提取，并通过回报重新加权机制进行整合。在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验表明，EFCA始终在强基线任务成功和任务质量方面取得提升，突显了基于环境的多时间尺度归因分配在长时程具身RL中的有效性。

articles.title: The Replay Gap: Static Evaluation of Model Switching in LLM Agents Scores the Wrong World
articles.abstract: LLM routers promise efficiency by matching each request to the cheapest adequate model, and are increasingly applied per step inside multi-step agents. Yet agentic routers are evaluated like single-turn routers: by replaying logged trajectories and substituting another model's recorded outputs, assuming the rest of the trajectory is unaffected. We test this assumption with branching rollouts: we fork live SWE-bench agent trajectories at controlled points, rebuild the environment, continue each fork with a different model, and compare against same-model control forks that isolate sampling and replay noise. Across six paired runs (~900 rollouts), swaps exceed their matched control floors by +0.25 to +0.66 normalized edit distance (multiplicity-corrected CIs exclude zero), rewriting 61-94% of post-fork actions; 74-77% of early swaps diverge at the first post-fork action, versus 6-35% of controls, leaving only 3% of replayed states valid. Divergence decreases with fork depth in both directions. All five outcome flips we observe occur in swap arms, upgrades rescuing unsolved instances and a downgrade losing the sole solve, and zero occur across 359 control forks. Scoring these same swaps with a log-stitching replay evaluator, replay mispredicts every success-relevant outcome call and predicts patches with 0.00-0.11 similarity to reality. Auditing the noise floor, temperature-0 "determinism" is configuration-dependent: FP8-served controls diverge on over 90% of forks while AWQ-served ones remain near-identical; and under tight budgets the stronger model more often exhausts its steps without submitting. Replay-based benchmarks score the wrong world for agentic routing; we release our harness and all trajectories.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling 2026. Code: https://github.com/AshrithaG/replay-gap Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ashritha0907/replay-gap-trajectories
articles.titleCn: 重放差距：对大型语言模型代理中模型切换的静态评估得出了错误的评价
articles.abstractCn: LLM 路由器通过将每个请求匹配到最合适的廉价模型来承诺效率，并且正越来越多地应用于多步代理的每一步。然而，代理式路由器像单轮路由器一样被评估：通过重放记录的轨迹并替换另一个模型的记录输出，假设其余轨迹不受影响。我们通过分支式扩展来测试这一假设：我们在受控点分叉实时 SWE-bench 代理轨迹，重建环境，用不同模型继续每个分叉，并与隔离采样和重放噪声的相同模型控制分叉进行比较。在六次配对运行（约900次扩展）中，交换值超过其匹配控制基准值 +0.25 到 +0.66 的标准化编辑距离（校正倍数的置信区间排除了零），重写了 61-94% 的分叉后动作；74-77% 的早期交换在第一个分叉后动作时就出现分歧，而对照实验中只有 6-35%，只有 3% 的重放状态有效。分歧程度随着分叉深度在两个方向上都减少。我们观察到的所有五个结果翻转都发生在交换臂中，升级挽救了未解决的实例，而降级失去了唯一的解决方案，并且在 359 个对照分叉中未发生零次。使用日志拼接重放评估器对相同的交换进行评分，重放错误预测了每个与成功相关的结果调用，并且预测的补丁与现实的相似度为 0.00-0.11。审计噪声基准，温度-0 的“确定性”取决于配置：FP8 服务的对照实验在超过 90% 的分叉上出现分歧，而 AWQ 服务的对照实验几乎保持相同；在严格的预算下，更强的模型更经常耗尽其步骤而未提交。基于重放基准的评估为代理路由评分错误；我们发布了我们的测试框架和所有轨迹。

articles.title: SAGE: SLO-Aware Adaptive Retrieval for Production RAG Systems
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in production operate under strict service level objectives (SLOs) on tail latency and infrastructure cost. However, standard retrieval pipelines rely on fixed retrieval budgets that ignore query difficulty, over-retrieving for easy queries and under-serving hard ones, forcing operators to trade answer quality against SLO compliance. This paper proposes SAGE, a learned SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy that dynamically selects the number of passages k per query. SAGE uses lightweight features derived from initial retrieval (e.g., score distributions, rank gaps, lexical signals) and is trained offline via imitation learning from an oracle that approximates optimal latency-quality trade-offs. At inference, it adds no LLM calls and minimal overhead. On Natural Questions, under a 5s P95 latency SLO, SAGE achieves 95% SLO compliance versus 30% for the best static baseline (k=20), reduces P95 latency by 36% and retrieval cost by 51% with only 2 percentage points Exact Match (EM) loss. A single policy trained on Natural Questions generalizes across HotpotQA, UnSeenTimeQA, and four LLM families (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma), consistently yielding +45-52 point SLO improvements without quality degradation.

articles.titleCn: SAGE：面向生产RAG系统的SLO感知自适应检索
articles.abstractCn: 生产环境中的检索增强生成（RAG）系统在尾部延迟和基础设施成本方面遵循严格的服务水平目标（SLO）。然而，标准的检索流程依赖于固定的检索预算，忽略了查询难度，导致对简单查询过度检索，对复杂查询服务不足，迫使操作员在答案质量与SLO合规性之间进行权衡。本文提出了SAGE，一种学习型SLO感知自适应检索策略，该策略动态选择每个查询的段落数量k。SAGE利用初始检索产生的轻量级特征（例如，分数分布、排名差距、词汇信号），并通过模仿学习从近似最优延迟质量权衡的“神谕”中离线训练。在推理时，它不会增加LLM调用，且开销极小。在自然问题数据集上，在5秒P95延迟SLO下，SAGE实现了95%的SLO合规性，而最佳静态基线（k=20）仅为30%，SAGE将P95延迟降低了36%，检索成本降低了51%，且仅损失了2个百分点的精确匹配（EM）。在自然问题数据集上训练的单个策略可以泛化到HotpotQA、UnSeenTimeQA和四种LLM系列（Llama、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma），始终如一地带来+45-52点的SLO改进，且不会降低质量。

articles.title: LatticeMind: A Conflict-Aware Memory Primitive for Multi-Agent Systems
articles.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems often fail not for lack of candidate answers, but because they have no persistent mechanism for deciding which incompatible claim should currently be trusted. Majority vote, debate, and judge-based selection choose an output without recording which claim wins, which is contested, or why a later update supersedes it. We present \term{LatticeMind}, a conflict-aware structured memory that handles contradiction at write time. It maintains explicit item status, applies cheap symbolic conflict checks, and invokes LLM reconciliation only for unresolved semantic cases. On a label-blind ConflictBank evaluation that removes source-name hints, LatticeMind reaches 0.97 accuracy versus 0.61 for the strongest aggregation baseline, with the gap significant at $p<10^{-6}$ by paired McNemar test. Ablations show that removing the checker or the reconciler costs 12 to 14 points. On four secondary planning benchmarks the picture is mixed: LatticeMind beats naive merge on three of four, but does not replace deliberation methods on tasks rewarding iterative search.
articles.titleCn: 晶格心智：面向多智能体系统的冲突感知内存原语
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体LLM系统往往不是因为候选答案不足而失败，而是缺乏决定当前应信任哪个不兼容主张的持久机制。多数投票、辩论和基于法官的选择机制在选定输出时不记录哪个主张获胜、哪个主张受到质疑或为什么后续更新会取代它。我们提出了\term{LatticeMind}，一种具有冲突感知的有序结构化记忆，它在写入时处理矛盾。它维护明确的项目状态，应用廉价的符号冲突检查，并且仅在未解决的语义情况下才调用LLM协调。在移除源名称提示的、盲标签的ConflictBank评估中，LatticeMind达到0.97的准确率，而最强的聚合基线仅为0.61，根据配对McNemar检验，差距在$p<10^{-6}$时具有显著性。消融实验表明，移除检查器或协调器会导致12到14分的损失。在四个次要规划基准测试中，结果呈现混合状态：LatticeMind在四个任务中的三个上优于朴素合并，但在奖励迭代搜索的任务上并未取代审议方法。

articles.title: Focus particles and scalar inferences across humans and language models
articles.abstract: Focus particles such as "even" and "only" are central to formal semantic theories that posit structured representations over sets of alternatives. "Even" highlights unexpected or extreme alternatives, while "only" enforces exclusivity. If such scalar representations are robust and generalizable, they should give rise to consistent judgments across contexts and systems. In this work, we test whether humans and large language models (LLMs) construct stable scalar representations from sentences containing these particles. Using a dataset of approximately 100 items, participants and models were asked to make scalar judgments. Preliminary results suggest that similar outputs across humans and LLMs may arise from different underlying mechanisms.
articles.comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, presented at 9th annual Conference on Cognitive Computational Neuroscience
articles.titleCn: 跨人类和语言模型的焦点粒子和标量推理
articles.abstractCn: 诸如“甚至”和“仅”之类的聚焦词是那些在备选集合上提出结构化表征的形式语义理论的核心。“甚至”突出意外或极端的备选方案，而“仅”则强调排他性。如果这种标量表征是稳健且可推广的，那么它们应该能在不同语境和系统中产生一致的判断。在本研究中，我们测试了人类和大型语言模型（LLM）是否能从包含这些词的句子中构建稳定的标量表征。使用一个包含约100个项目的数据集，参与者和模型被要求做出标量判断。初步结果表明，人类和LLM之间相似的输出可能源于不同的潜在机制。

articles.title: Harmful Content Is Not Enough: Continuation Framing Moderates In-Context Emergent Misalignment
articles.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) can induce emergent misalignment (EM), where narrow misaligned examples alter answers to unrelated questions. Existing prompts, however, conflate harmful-text exposure with an invitation to continue assistant behavior. We hold harmful answers fixed while varying their delivery as demonstrations, evidence, assistant history, or tool output. Across ten independently sampled contexts, demonstration framing raises broad EM by $30$--$32$ percentage points on a susceptible Gemini model; the gap survives domain exclusion, semantic clustering, unseen questions, and four prompt templates. Format and length-matched controls show that harmful content is necessary but insufficient. A role times continuation factorial further reveals model-dependent provenance effects: Gemini follows both assistant and tool histories, whereas Grok largely resists tool-framed continuation. Several other frontier and open-weight models show no gap. Blinded human audits confirm every main contrast and show that the model judge underestimates active-condition failures. Thus continuation framing is a strong, model-dependent moderator of ICL-EM, not a universal consequence of harmful context.
articles.titleCn: 有害内容并不足够：延续框架调节了情境中的涌现性错位
articles.abstractCn: 情境学习（ICL）可能引发涌现性错位（EM），即狭义错位示例会改变与无关问题的答案。然而，现有提示将有害文本暴露与邀请继续助手行为混淆。我们保持有害答案固定，而改变其呈现方式作为示例、证据、助手历史或工具输出。在十个独立抽样的情境中，示例框架使易受感染的Gemini模型上的广泛EM提高了30至32个百分点；这种差距在领域排除、语义聚类、未见问题以及四种提示模板中依然存在。格式和长度匹配的控制实验表明，有害内容是必要的但不充分。角色与延续性因子的进一步研究揭示了模型相关的来源效应：Gemini既遵循助手历史也遵循工具历史，而Grok在很大程度上抵制工具框架的延续性。其他几个前沿和开放权重模型则显示出无差距现象。盲法人工审核证实了所有主要对比，并表明模型判断者低估了主动条件下的失败。因此，延续性框架是ICL-EM的一个强大且模型相关的调节因素，而非有害情境的普遍结果。

articles.title: Quantization Degradation in Large Language Models: A Signal-Noise Perspective
articles.abstract: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of large language models, yet how severely a quantized model degrades is not determined by bit-width alone. We systematically study weight-only post-training quantization across bit-widths, quantization methods, model scales and downstream tasks on multiple model families. We observe that such degradation varies substantially across these factors: 4-bit quantization usually preserves performance, 2-bit often causes broad degradation, and at 3-bit, degradation becomes apparent but varies markedly with task type, quantization method and model scale. To explain this variability, we use the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to measure how strongly quantization perturbs full-precision representations. We trace degradation back to two linked processes: how quantization errors arise within individual modules, and how they accumulate across layers. First, a source SNR decomposition shows that newly introduced errors depend on three factors: the magnitude of the weight error, the strength of the task-specific signal, and how strongly the quantization error aligns with task-specific activations. Different factors affect these components in distinct ways. Second, a cross-layer propagation analysis shows that these errors can be attenuated, preserved, or amplified as they pass across layers, and that larger models benefit from weaker error amplification. Together, these results establish that quantization degradation is governed by how errors are introduced at the source and how they accumulate across the network.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型的量化退化：从信号-噪声视角来看
articles.abstractCn: 训练后量化可以降低大型语言模型的部署成本，但量化模型性能的下降程度并不仅仅由位宽决定。我们系统地研究了不同位宽、量化方法、模型规模和下游任务下仅权重训练后量化的影响，覆盖了多个模型家族。我们观察到这种性能下降程度在这些因素之间存在显著差异：4位量化通常能保持性能，2位量化往往导致广泛性能下降，而在3位时，性能下降变得明显，但会根据任务类型、量化方法和模型规模出现显著变化。为了解释这种可变性，我们使用信噪比（SNR）来衡量量化对全精度表示的扰动程度。我们将性能下降归因于两个相互关联的过程：量化误差如何在单个模块中产生，以及它们如何在层间累积。首先，一个源SNR分解表明，新引入的误差取决于三个因素：权重误差的幅度、特定任务的信号强度，以及量化误差与特定任务激活的匹配程度。不同因素以不同方式影响这些分量。其次，跨层传播分析表明，这些误差在层间传播时可能会被减弱、保留或放大，而更大的模型受益于较弱的误差放大。综合这些结果，我们得出结论，量化性能下降受源处误差引入方式和网络层间误差累积方式共同控制。

articles.title: A Grounded and Decomposed Framework for Relation-Level Hallucination Evaluation in Abstractive Summarization
articles.abstract: Abstractive text summarization systems frequently generate fluent yet unfaithful summaries by fabricating or distorting relationships between entities and events. Such relation-level hallucinations undermine the reliability of generated summaries, particularly in high-stakes domains. In this work, we present a refined and grounded framework for evaluating relation hallucination in abstractive summarization. We present the empirical Relation Hallucination Index (RHI) by introducing a dependency-aware relation extraction algorithm that incorporates lemmatization-based normalization, named entity grounded subject resolution, passive agent recovery, negation-aware verb modeling, reporting verb filtering, nominal relation fallback, clausal propagation, and systematic deduplication. These enhancements improve the structural fidelity of extracted relation triples and reduce spurious matches during evaluation. In addition, we introduce a normalized formulation of RHI to ensure scale-invariant comparison between datasets and models. The revised metric decomposes hallucination into interpretable components, aggregates relation hallucination metric into a normalized relation faithfulness score. Extensive evaluation across multiple state-of-the-art summarization models demonstrates that the grounded extraction process yields more stable and discriminative hallucination measurements. The proposed framework advances automated relation-level faithfulness evaluation and supports coherence-aware, hallucination-sensitive model analysis.
articles.titleCn: 抽象摘要中关系级幻觉评估的基于基础和分解的框架
articles.abstractCn: 抽象文本摘要系统常常通过虚构或扭曲实体与事件之间的关系来生成流畅但不忠实的摘要。这种关系层面的幻觉削弱了生成摘要的可靠性，特别是在高风险领域。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种精细且基于事实的关系幻觉评估框架，用于评估抽象摘要中的关系幻觉。我们通过引入一种依赖感知的关系抽取算法，提出了实证关系幻觉指数（RHI），该算法结合了基于词干提取的归一化、实体锚定主语解析、被动代理恢复、否定感知动词建模、报告动词过滤、名词关系回退、子句传播和系统化去重。这些改进提高了抽取关系三元组的结构保真度，并在评估过程中减少了虚假匹配。此外，我们引入了RHI的归一化公式，以确保数据集和模型之间的规模不变性比较。修订后的指标将幻觉分解为可解释的组成部分，将关系幻觉指标聚合为归一化的关系忠实度分数。在多个最先进的摘要模型上的广泛评估表明，基于事实的抽取过程产生了更稳定和更具区分度的幻觉测量结果。所提出的框架推进了自动化关系层面忠实度评估，并支持基于连贯性和幻觉敏感性的模型分析。

articles.title: Thinking vs. NoThinking: Towards Interpreting Reasoning Mechanisms of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
articles.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exhibit superior reasoning capabilities, the neural mechanisms distinguishing this explicit Thinking mode from direct answer generation (NoThinking mode) remain poorly understood. To deconstruct this cognitive process, we apply Top-K Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to the intermediate representations of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and examine the model's divergent behaviors across math-solving tasks of three distinct difficulty levels. Observationally, we identify a clear distinction in how the model functions under two reasoning modes: Thinking mode relies on sparse and high-intensity feature activations driving verbal deduction independent of problem complexity, whereas NoThinking mode exhibits an adaptive and diffuse pattern prioritizing symbolic manipulation. Causally, suppressing the three most active sparse features by Total Activation Volume reveals three principles: (i) reasoning and syntactic structure are tightly coupled, as interventions consistently degrade \LaTeX{} and boxed-solution formatting; (ii) Thinking responds to disruption with compensatory over-generation marked by increased metacognitive cues and repetitive, low-information continuations; and (iii) coherent CoT behavior depends on a fragile coordination among specialized features, yielding distinct failure modes under perturbation but a consistently impaired output structure.
articles.titleCn: 思考与无思考：通过稀疏自编码器解释大型语言模型的推理机制
articles.abstractCn: 尽管采用思维链（CoT）策略的大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出卓越的推理能力，但区分这种显式思维模式与直接答案生成（无思维模式）的神经机制仍知之甚少。为解析这一认知过程，我们运用Top-K稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）处理DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B的中间表征，并考察该模型在三个不同难度级别的数学解题任务中的行为差异。观察上，我们识别出模型在两种推理模式下的功能差异：思维模式依赖稀疏且高强度的特征激活驱动独立于问题复杂度的语言推理，而无思维模式则呈现适应性强且弥散的特征激活模式，优先考虑符号操作。因果上，通过抑制总激活体积最大的三个最活跃稀疏特征，揭示了三条原则：（i）推理与句法结构紧密耦合，干预始终导致LaTeX和方框解法格式的退化；（ii）思维模式通过补偿性过度生成应对干扰，表现为元认知线索增加和重复的低信息延续；（iii）连贯的CoT行为依赖于专业特征间的脆弱协调，扰动下产生不同的失效模式，但输出结构始终受损。

articles.title: STEMMA: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Self-Identity Consistency in LLMs
articles.abstract: Knowledge Distillation is a widely adopted technique in the training and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enabling transfer of structured information and functional behavior from a large teacher model to a smaller student model while significantly reducing computational costs. However, as the use of distillation increases in both scale and complexity it raises an important question about what kind of knowledge is really transferred from the teacher model. In this work, we argue that apart from the functional knowledge, student models also learn behavioral patterns, specifically how a model represents its own identity raising concerns about output homogeneity, model biases, and accountability. To address this challenge, we introduce STEMMA, a multi-modal and multi-agent framework in which role specific agents collaboratively probe self identification behavior in different models. We also contribute a set of adversarial prompts designed manually to evaluate identity consistency in LLMs. Our results show that to an extent most models are vulnerable to inconsistencies in self-representations.
articles.titleCn: STEMMA：一个用于评估大型语言模型自我身份一致性的对抗性多智能体框架
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏是大型语言模型（LLMs）训练和微调中广泛采用的一种技术，它能够将结构化信息和功能行为从大型教师模型迁移到较小的学生模型，同时显著降低计算成本。然而，随着蒸馏技术的应用规模和复杂性的增加，它引发了一个重要问题：教师模型究竟转移了哪些知识。在这项工作中，我们主张除了功能知识外，学生模型还学习了行为模式，特别是模型如何表现其自身身份，这引发了输出同质化、模型偏差和问责制等问题。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了STEMMA，这是一个多模态和多智能体的框架，其中特定角色的智能体协同探索不同模型中的自我识别行为。我们还贡献了一套手动设计的对抗性提示，用于评估LLMs中的身份一致性。我们的结果表明，在某种程度上，大多数模型都容易受到自我表征不一致性的影响。

articles.title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
articles.abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling. However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining long-horizon logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions. To address this, we formulate this challenge as Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP), and take interactive narrative as our testbed. We introduce NCP-Bench, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses. Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent. Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a substantial long-horizon consistency gap: high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 42% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40% to 68% across models, and only isolated runs satisfying all achievement commitments within the 100-turn limit.
articles.titleCn: LLM智能体能否遵循剧本？交互式叙事中长时程一致性的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展正在通过实现开放式和流畅的互动叙事，革新游戏领域的AI。然而，现有研究在很大程度上忽视了在不受约束的用户干预下保持长期逻辑一致性和叙事完整性的关键挑战。为此，我们将这一挑战定义为叙事承诺保持（NCP），并将互动叙事作为我们的测试平台。我们引入了NCP-Bench，这是一个包含100个叙事环境的基准测试，这些环境源自电影梗概。每个环境都包含一个结构化的叙事规范（轨迹、承诺和初始事实），我们可以在玩家代理与叙述代理的互动过程中自动进行检查。跨当前最先进LLM的实验揭示了一个显著的长期一致性差距：高语言质量并不能保证承诺的保持；即使是强大的模型在对抗性干预下也经常生成逻辑冲突的内容，表现最佳的模型（GPT-5.2）在20轮后仅达到42%的存活率，各模型的事实冲突率在40%至68%之间，且仅在100轮限制内才有孤立运行满足所有成就承诺。

articles.title: DS@GT ARC at Touché: Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Debate
articles.abstract: We extend the DS@GT ARC working-note submission to the Touché 2025 Retrieval-Augmented Debate task. The task has two subtasks: generating the next utterance in a simulated debate, and evaluating debate responses according to the Gricean maxims of Quantity, Quality, Relation, and Manner. The DS@GT ARC submission consisted of six leading LLMs from three providers through a retrieval-augmented prompting pipeline. We summarize the results from the working paper and explore whether multi-LLM evaluator agreement is a reliable proxy for official evaluation performance. The analysis shows that frontier LLM systems are strong response generators, and as evaluators they agree strongly within model families. However this consensus does not reliably track the official evaluation target, with the largest gap on the Quality maxim. The accompanying source code for this paper is located at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad and https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad-analysis.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in the CLEF 2026 Best of Labs proceedings
articles.titleCn: 在Touché上，DS@GT ARC：用于检索增强辩论的大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们将DS@GT ARC工作笔记提交扩展至Touché 2025检索增强辩论任务。该任务包含两个子任务：生成模拟辩论中的下一句话，以及根据格莱斯数量、质量、关联和方式准则评估辩论回复。DS@GT ARC提交包含来自三家供应商的六个领先大型语言模型，通过检索增强提示流程。我们从工作笔记中总结结果，并探讨多大型语言模型评估器的一致性是否是官方评估性能的可靠代理。分析表明，前沿大型语言模型系统是强大的回复生成器，作为评估器时，它们在模型家族内部高度一致。然而，这种共识并不能可靠地追踪官方评估目标，在质量准则上存在最大差距。本文的配套源代码位于 https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad 和 https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad-analysis。

articles.title: Accurate Ensembles, Fragile Narratives: Multi-Scale Stacking and a Fidelity Audit of LLM-Generated Explanations for Credit Risk
articles.abstract: Credit scoring increasingly relies on models whose decision logic cannot be read off their parameters, in tension with supervisory expectations that adverse decisions be explainable. A common proposal closes that gap with a language model: compute feature attributions, hand them to an LLM, and let it write the rationale. We build such a system end to end and test whether the second half of the promise holds. The predictive component is a multi-scale stacking ensemble fusing four differently regularised gradient-boosting learners with a residual network through a neural meta-learner trained on out-of-fold predictions. On a public 32,581-application credit dataset it reaches test ROC-AUC 0.9539 (95% CI [0.9462, 0.9616]) and PR-AUC 0.9137, beating the best single model by Delta-AUC = 0.0143 (p = 0.016 under a conservative independence assumption). Our central finding is asymmetric. The ranking gain is real but operationally small: at the F1-optimal threshold the ensemble avoids only six additional missed defaults out of 1,422 against a tuned random forest, cutting cost-weighted loss by under 2%. The narrative layer fails in a way prompt engineering alone does not fix. In an audited case the model named three factors as risk-increasing that the supplied attributions scored as risk-reducing, omitted the dominant driver, and introduced a feature never given to it. We trace this to properties we measure rather than assume: SHAP and LIME agree on which features matter (overlap@10 = 0.80) but not on their order (tau = 0.43, p = 0.18), and the attribution sign for the model's most sensitive input is near a coin flip across applicants (modal-sign share 0.53). Calibration (ECS = 0.117) and perturbation stability (DPD = 0.078) both fall short of our own thresholds. Constrained prompting is necessary but not sufficient: grounding must be verified after generation, not assumed.
articles.titleCn: 精确集成，脆弱叙事：多尺度堆叠与信贷风险评估中LLM生成解释的保真度审计
articles.abstractCn: 信用评分越来越依赖那些决策逻辑无法从其参数中直接读出的模型，这与监管机构对不利决策可解释性的期望相冲突。一个常见的建议通过语言模型弥补这一差距：计算特征归因，将其交给大型语言模型，并让模型撰写推理理由。我们端到端构建了这样的系统，并测试了承诺的后半部分是否成立。预测组件是一个融合了四个不同正则化的梯度提升学习器与残差网络的多元尺度堆叠集成模型，通过一个在折叠外预测上训练的神经元元学习器进行融合。在一个包含32,581个申请的公开信用数据集上，它达到了测试ROC-AUC 0.9539（95%置信区间[0.9462, 0.9616]）和PR-AUC 0.9137，比最佳单一模型提高了Delta-AUC = 0.0143（在保守的独立性假设下，p = 0.016）。我们的核心发现是不对称的。排名提升是真实的，但操作上微不足道：在F1最优阈值下，集成模型与调优的随机森林相比，仅避免了1,422个额外违约中的6个，将成本加权损失降低了不到2%。叙事层的问题无法仅通过提示工程解决。在一个经过审计的案例中，模型指出了三个增加风险的因子，而这些因子在提供的归因中被评分为客户减少风险，遗漏了主要驱动因素，并引入了一个从未提供给它的特征。我们将此归因于我们测量的属性而非假设的属性：SHAP和LIME在哪些特征重要上达成一致（overlap@10 = 0.80），但在它们的顺序上并不一致（tau = 0.43，p = 0.18），模型最敏感输入的归因符号在申请人中接近于抛硬币（modal-sign份额0.53）。校准（ECS = 0.117）和扰动稳定性（DPD = 0.078）均未达到我们自己的阈值。约束提示是必要的，但不是充分的：生成后的基础必须验证，而非假设。

articles.title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs
articles.abstract: Multimodal expansion of large language models (LLMs) enables new perceptual capabilities but often compromises the language intelligence acquired during pretraining. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from the perspective of internal adaptation dynamics and discover that neurons in pretrained LLMs exhibit heterogeneous plasticity during multimodal learning: some neurons are critical for preserving language capabilities, while others are more adaptive to multimodal knowledge. Based on this insight, we propose NeuPAT (Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that allocates neuron-wise update constraints during multimodal instruction tuning. NeuPAT uses a small-scale probing stage to estimate neuron adaptation patterns and selectively protects language-sensitive neurons while promoting multimodal adaptation through more plastic neurons. Experiments across diverse LLM families demonstrate that NeuPAT recovers 94.5\% of the language capability degradation caused by vanilla tuning on 11 language benchmarks while maintaining comparable multimodal performance, providing an effective approach for capability-preserving multimodal expansion.
articles.titleCn: NeuPAT：针对语言保留型MLLM的神经元感知可塑性分配调优
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的多模态扩展虽然赋予了新的感知能力，但往往牺牲了预训练期间获得的语言智能。本研究从内部适应动态的角度探究这一现象，发现预训练LLM中的神经元在多模态学习过程中表现出异质性可塑性：部分神经元对保持语言能力至关重要，而另一些神经元则更能适应多模态知识。基于这一发现，我们提出了NeuPAT（神经元感知可塑性分配微调），这是一个轻量级且与架构无关的框架，在多模态指令微调期间对神经元进行逐个更新约束分配。NeuPAT通过小规模探测阶段估计神经元适应模式，选择性地保护语言敏感神经元，同时通过更具可塑性的神经元促进多模态适应。跨不同LLM系列的实验表明，NeuPAT在11个语言基准上恢复了94.5%的常规微调导致的语言能力退化，同时保持了相当的多模态性能，为能力保持型多模态扩展提供了一种有效方法。

articles.title: Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs
articles.abstract: Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language homogeneous training data requires a clearer understanding of the contribution of translated multilingual supervision. We examine this question using 742 proverb concepts across 6,787 translated instances in seven languages. We evaluate five models, including multilingual encoders and instruction tuned LLMs, under progressively increasing levels of multilingual supervision. Moreover, we introduce a multidimensional annotation framework for proverbs that characterizes them through four complementary figurative forms: Metaphorical, Moral/Advisory, Cause-Effect, and Culture Specific. Our findings show that approximately 50% of the translated multilingual training data is sufficient to achieve near-optimal figurative language identification performance. We further show that combining diverse figurative forms yields the strongest overall performance. A notable finding is that the least frequent figurative form, Culture Specific, exhibits the largest performance gains under multilingual supervision. Furthermore, the Moral/Advisory and Culture Specific forms contribute most to the performance of instruction-tuned LLMs on figurative language identification. These findings motivate multilingual figurative language identification to move beyond metaphor-centric taxonomies toward concept level multidimensional frameworks that explicitly model complementary forms of figurative meaning.
articles.titleCn: 统一中的智慧：多语言训练在谚语隐喻语言识别中的作用
articles.abstractCn: 尽管多语言方法在隐喻语言识别方面并非新事物，但超越语言同质化训练数据的转变需要更清晰地理解翻译多语言监督的贡献。我们通过分析七种语言中742个谚语概念，涵盖6,787个翻译实例，来探讨这一问题。我们在逐步增加的多语言监督水平下评估了五种模型，包括多语言编码器和指令微调的大型语言模型。此外，我们引入了一个多维谚语标注框架，通过四种互补的隐喻形式——隐喻、道德/建议、因果关系和文化特定——来描述谚语。我们的研究结果表明，大约50%的翻译多语言训练数据足以实现接近最优的隐喻语言识别性能。我们进一步证明，结合多样化的隐喻形式能产生最强的整体性能。一个显著的发现是，最不频繁的隐喻形式“文化特定”在多语言监督下表现出最大的性能提升。此外，“道德/建议”和“文化特定”形式对指令微调的大型语言模型在隐喻语言识别方面的性能贡献最大。这些发现推动多语言隐喻语言识别超越以隐喻为中心的分类体系，转向明确建模隐喻意义互补形式的概念级多维框架。

articles.title: Archer: Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) iteratively refine a sequence, allowing earlier predictions to be revised as context evolves. This rollback capability distinguishes them from irreversible autoregressive generation, but makes inference costly. Every denoising update alters the global context, forcing both prompt and response states to be recomputed even though only response tokens are revisable. Key-value (KV) caching could reduce this cost, yet conventional caching assumes immutable historical states and is therefore difficult to reconcile with rollback. In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback (Archer), a training-free KV caching method for rollback-capable DLMs. Archer asymmetrically keeps the mutable response synchronized with the current hypothesis while reusing prompt K/V within a bounded state neighborhood. Although prompt representations also change under bidirectional attention, their token identities remain fixed; bounded reuse therefore amortizes repeated prompt computation without caching mutable response states. It also delays feedback from tentative tokens, reducing premature reinforcement of transient high-confidence errors and giving rollback more opportunity to correct them. Our analysis characterizes prompt reuse as a reversibility-aligned cache boundary, bounds its state-dependent approximation error, and gives a decoder-margin condition for preserving full-refresh decisions. Existing DLM acceleration often trades quality for speed. Archer shifts this frontier, attaining the best mean performance of 33.63% together with a 2.57x mean speedup on the main suite. Across evaluated settings, it improves Pass@1 by up to 3.05 points and reaches up to 2.95x speedup. Controlled analyses connect the quality gain to delayed prompt feedback and validate state-aware refresh. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hxnng/Archer.
articles.titleCn: 弓箭手：用于扩散语言模型高效回滚的缓存隐藏状态自适应重用
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）通过迭代优化序列，允许随着上下文的演变而修正早期的预测。这种回滚能力将它们与不可逆的自回归生成区分开来，但也使得推理成本高昂。每次去噪更新都会改变全局上下文，迫使提示状态和响应状态都被重新计算，尽管只有响应标记是可修正的。键值（KV）缓存可以减少这种成本，但传统缓存假设历史状态不可变，因此难以与回滚协调。在本文中，我们引入了自适应重用缓存的隐藏状态以实现高效回滚（Archer），这是一种针对具有回滚能力的DLMs的无训练KV缓存方法。Archer不对称地保持可变响应与当前假设同步，同时在一个有界的状态邻域内重用提示K/V。尽管提示表示在双向注意力下也会发生变化，但它们的标记身份保持固定；有界重用因此摊销了重复的提示计算，而无需缓存可变响应状态。它还延迟了试探性标记的反馈，减少了过早强化瞬时高置信度错误，并为回滚提供了更多机会来纠正它们。我们的分析将提示重用描述为与可逆性对齐的缓存边界，界定了其状态相关的近似误差，并给出了一个解码器边界条件以保留全刷新决策。现有的DLM加速通常以牺牲质量换取速度。Archer将这一前沿转移，在主要套件中实现了33.63%的最佳平均性能，并实现了2.57倍的平均加速。在评估的各种设置中，它将Pass@1提高了高达3.05分，并达到了高达2.95倍的加速。受控分析将质量提升与延迟的提示反馈联系起来，并验证了状态感知刷新。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Hxnng/Archer获取。

articles.title: Commitment Before Realization: When Classifier-Free Guidance Becomes Unnecessary in Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is usually kept on throughout masked diffusion language model decoding, although its benefit varies across prompts and over time. We study when CFG is actually needed by comparing, from any partial output, the probability of eventual constraint satisfaction under continued CFG and under base-only continuation. Their difference defines the remaining value of guidance. Guidance dependence is highly prompt-specific. Many prompts already succeed without CFG, while for others it provides no measurable benefit or can be harmful. For prompts that do benefit, the gain is often concentrated early. We define the commitment horizon $\astar$ as the earliest point from which switching all remaining decoding to the base model reduces final success by no more than a chosen tolerance. Under the base model, the corresponding success probability, or committor, is a martingale. To first order, CFG's per-step effect is governed by the covariance between the guidance logit direction and the successor committor. This gives a local account of when guidance can help, but it does not by itself locate the horizon. Among prompts with an observed preterminal horizon, $\astar$ is usually early and varies more within constraint families than between them. Freezing each prompt at its own cross-fitted horizon is noninferior to full CFG on all 13 subtasks at the prespecified margin, even while many tokens remain masked. This separates commitment from realization. The boundary also identifies a later region in which higher parallelism adds only a small cost in constraint success, although fluency still degrades with parallel width. For failed trajectories, reopening committed positions improves recovery in both failure modes.
articles.titleCn: 实现之前之承诺：当分类器无关引导在掩码扩散语言模型中变得不再必要
articles.abstractCn: 无分类器引导（CFG）通常在整个掩码扩散语言模型解码过程中保持开启，尽管其效益因提示和随时间变化而不同。我们通过比较从任何部分输出开始，在持续CFG和仅基于基础模型延续的情况下最终满足约束的概率，来研究何时实际需要CFG。它们的差异定义了引导的剩余价值。引导依赖性高度特定于提示。许多提示在不使用CFG的情况下已经成功，而其他提示则可能无法带来可衡量的效益甚至可能有害。对于确实受益的提示，收益通常集中在早期。我们定义承诺范围$\astar$为从该点开始切换所有剩余解码到基础模型，最终成功率降低不超过选定容忍度的最早点。在基础模型下，相应的成功率或承诺者是一个鞅。在第一阶上，CFG的每步效应受引导logit方向与后继承诺者之间的协方差控制。这给出了一个局部描述，指导何时能提供帮助，但它本身并不能定位范围。在观察到预终端范围的提示中，$\astar$通常很早，并且在约束家族内部的差异大于家族之间的差异。将每个提示冻结在其交叉拟合的范围，在预设的边际上，即使许多标记仍然被掩码，也比在所有13个子任务上完全使用CFG非劣。这区分了承诺与实现。边界还标识了一个后期区域，其中更高的并行性在约束成功率上只增加了较小的成本，尽管流畅性仍然随着并行宽度下降。对于失败的轨迹，重新打开已承诺的位置在两种失败模式中都改善了恢复。

articles.title: DialectS2S: End-to-End Speech Dialogue Modeling for Low-Resource Chinese Dialects
articles.abstract: Current end-to-end speech dialogue models are primarily optimized for mainstream languages and remain limited in low-resource dialect scenarios due to the scarcity of dialect speech data. Moreover, during dialect adaptation, the semantic representation space of speech dialogue models continuously evolves, while conventional speech supervision remains unchanged, leading to semantic inconsistency between hidden representations and speech targets and degrading speech stability and naturalness. To address these issues, we propose DialectS2S, an end-to-end speech dialogue model for Chinese dialects. We first develop a scalable dialect speech dialogue synthesis pipeline for efficient data construction. We further introduce a two-stage post-training strategy with self-aligned speech supervision, which aligns the semantic content of speech supervision with the evolved semantic representations of the model to improve dialect speech generation quality. Experimental results show that DialectS2S consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple Chinese dialects in speech dialogue, achieving substantial improvements in dialect consistency, response quality, and speech intelligibility. Our work provides an efficient and scalable solution for end-to-end speech dialogue modeling in low-resource dialect scenarios. To facilitate future research and practical applications, we fully open-source the DialectS2S framework, including model checkpoints, training datasets, and fine-tuning code.
articles.titleCn: DialectS2S：面向低资源汉语方言的端到端语音对话建模
articles.abstractCn: 当前的端到端语音对话模型主要针对主流语言进行优化，但由于方言语音数据的稀缺性，在低资源方言场景下仍存在局限性。此外，在方言适配过程中，语音对话模型的语义表示空间会持续演变，而传统语音监督保持不变，导致隐藏表示与语音目标之间出现语义不一致，从而降低语音的稳定性和自然度。为解决这些问题，我们提出了DialectS2S，一个针对中文方言的端到端语音对话模型。我们首先开发了一个可扩展的方言语音对话合成流程，以实现高效的数据构建。我们进一步引入了一种具有自对齐语音监督的两阶段后训练策略，该策略将语音监督的语义内容与模型演变的语义表示进行对齐，以提升方言语音生成质量。实验结果表明，DialectS2S在多个中文方言的语音对话任务中始终优于现有基线，在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度方面取得了显著提升。我们的工作为低资源方言场景下的端到端语音对话建模提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。为促进未来的研究和实际应用，我们全面开源了DialectS2S框架，包括模型检查点、训练数据集和微调代码。

articles.title: APEX-VW: A Document-Level English-Spanish Post-Editing Dataset in the Healthcare Domain
articles.abstract: Post-Editing (PE) of Machine Translation (MT) output often involves repeating the same lexical and terminological corrections across many segments, especially in specialised and highly repetitive documents. Despite substantial work on Automatic Post-Editing (APE), most available corpora operate at the sentence level, others are synthetic, and overall not designed to study how corrections propagate in realistic Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) workflows. This paper presents the APEX-VW (Automatic Post-Editing eXperiments on Virtual Wards) Corpus, a new open English-Spanish (EN-ES) dataset built from recent NHS virtual-ward documents and professional PE in Trados Studio, with controlled MT, terminology, and quality assurance settings. The corpus contains seven document-coherent source texts totalling 42k words, translated with four MT systems representing different paradigms and then post-edited by professional translators. Unlike prior resources such as WMT APE corpora, eSCAPE, MLQE-PE, or LangMark, the dataset preserves document order and CAT-tool context, making it suitable for research on terminology normalisation, correction propagation, and human-in-the-loop translation support. The paper describes the corpus design, data preparation, PE setup, and initial corpus statistics, and positions the resource as a benchmark for document-level APE and propagation-aware assistive tools.
articles.titleCn: APEX-VW：医疗领域英语-西班牙语文档级后编辑数据集
articles.abstractCn: 机器翻译（MT）输出的后期编辑（PE）通常涉及在许多段落中重复相同的词汇和术语修正，尤其是在专业性强且高度重复的文档中。尽管在自动后期编辑（APE）方面已进行了大量研究，但大多数可用语料库仅在句子级别操作，其他则是合成语料，总体上并未设计用于研究修正如何在现实的计算机辅助翻译（CAT）工作流程中传播。本文介绍了APEX-VW（虚拟病房自动后期编辑实验）语料库，这是一个新的开放英语-西班牙语（EN-ES）数据集，由最近的NHS虚拟病房文档和Trados Studio中的专业PE构建而成，具有受控的MT、术语和质量保证设置。该语料库包含七个文档连贯的源文本，总计42k个单词，由四个代表不同范式的MT系统翻译，然后由专业翻译进行后期编辑。与WMT APE语料库、eSCAPE、MLQE-PE或LangMark等先前资源不同，该数据集保留了文档顺序和CAT工具上下文，使其适合于术语规范化、修正传播和人工参与翻译支持的研究。本文描述了语料库设计、数据准备、PE设置和初始语料库统计数据，并将该资源定位为文档级APE和传播感知辅助工具的基准。

articles.title: Decided Upstream, Written Late: Locating and Pricing the Cross-Lingual Refusal Circuit of a Multilingual MoE
articles.abstract: Safety alignment in multilingual models is uneven: a model that reliably refuses a harmful request in English will often comply with the same request in a lower-resource language. We trace this gap mechanistically in sarvam, an Indic-multilingual mixture-of-experts reasoning model, and find it is not a failure to detect harm. Harm is encoded as an internal direction that is nearly language-invariant in mid-network (English-vs-Indic cosine ${\approx}0.9$ at $L11$), and steering that direction upstream causally controls refusal. But the detection direction is orthogonal to the change that actually writes the refusal, which is late and assembled over the course of generation rather than read off in a single forward pass. We attribute the write to a specific, localizable circuit, a mixture-of-experts writer held in check by an attention opposer and price every way of intervening on it: damping the opposer is cheap and effective, amplifying the writer is a cost wall, and surgical edits to the responsible heads do nothing. The circuit's organization, and the gradient method that exposes it, recur in a second, unrelated MoE model, while the lever's strength is architecture-specific. The result is a cost-measured map of where a multilingual safety repair can land, and what it costs
articles.comment: Accepted to the actionable Interpretability workshop at COLM 2026
articles.titleCn: 上游决策，后期撰写：定位与定价多语言MoE的跨语言拒绝电路
articles.abstractCn: 多语言模型中的安全对齐存在不均衡现象：一个在英语中可靠拒绝有害请求的模型，往往会在低资源语言中同意同样的请求。我们在梵语多语言专家混合推理模型（sarvam）中机制性地追踪了这种差距，发现这不是检测危害的失败。危害被编码为网络中部的内部方向，该方向几乎不受语言影响（英语与梵语余弦相似度在L11层约为0.9），而引导该方向上游因果关系则控制着拒绝行为。但检测方向与实际写入拒绝内容的方向正交，后者是生成过程中后期才组装完成的，而非单次前向传递中读取的。我们将写入归因于一个特定且可定位的电路——由注意力反对者约束的专家混合写入器，干预它的任何方式都会付出代价：削弱反对者既便宜又有效，增强写入器则面临成本壁垒，而针对负责头部的手术性编辑则毫无作用。该电路的组织结构及其揭示梯度的方法在另一个无关的MoE模型中重现，而杠杆的强度具有架构特异性。最终结果是一个成本测量的多语言安全修复落地位置及成本图谱。

articles.title: Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP): Hallucination Detection in LLMs from Hidden States
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and useful responses but remain prone to hallucinations. We introduce Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP), a white-box method for answer-level hallucination detection from the hidden states of a frozen LLM. PEP extends standard linear probes by augmenting the input with a small number of learnable prompt embeddings. We evaluate PEP on TriviaQA, GSM8K, and MedQA using Qwen3 models at multiple scales. PEP improves hidden-state-based detection over standard linear probes in the main in-distribution setting. We further evaluate PEP for pre-generation prediction, cross-model transfer, and out-of-distribution generalization. PEP remains effective in the pre-generation and cross-model settings, whereas robust cross-dataset transfer remains difficult. These results show that prompt-based adaptation can strengthen hidden-state probing while keeping the backbone frozen and adding only a small number of trainable parameters.
articles.titleCn: 提示嵌入探针（PEP）：从隐藏状态检测大型语言模型的幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成流畅且有用的回复，但仍然容易产生幻觉。我们介绍了Prompt Embedding Probes（PEP），这是一种基于冻结LLM的隐藏状态的答案级幻觉检测的白盒方法。PEP通过在输入中添加少量可学习的提示嵌入来扩展标准的线性探针。我们在TriviaQA、GSM8K和MedQA上使用不同规模的Qwen3模型评估了PEP。PEP在主要的分布内设置中提高了基于隐藏状态的检测效果，优于标准的线性探针。我们进一步评估了PEP在预生成预测、跨模型迁移和分布外泛化方面的性能。PEP在预生成和跨模型设置中仍然有效，但稳健的跨数据集迁移仍然具有挑战性。这些结果表明，基于提示的适配可以增强隐藏状态探针，同时保持主干冻结，并仅添加少量可训练参数。

articles.title: The Voiceprint Fallacy: Why Voices Are Not Unique Biometric Imprints
articles.abstract: In recent years, the term voiceprint has regained attention, particularly in technological applications and policy-making contexts, often carrying the assumption that a person's voice constitutes a stable and unique biometric trace analogous to a fingerprint. Yet this conception has been repeatedly criticized and rejected by forensic voice experts throughout the decades since its introduction. Although voices undoubtedly contain speaker-related information, this simplified conception obscures the highly dynamic and context-dependent nature of speech. This article revisits the voiceprint fallacy and reconsiders what can count as evidence of speaker identity by reviewing the historical development of voiceprint identification, evidence on human voice variability, developments in forensic voice comparison, research on human and automatic speaker recognition, and the recent challenge posed by deepfake speech to speaker identity. We point out that the voiceprint metaphor and its underlying implications are scientifically misleading because they transform a probabilistic source of speaker information into an imagined stable object of identity. To avoid treating voices as imprint-like traces, we recommend that voice evidence be interpreted through validated and calibrated probabilistic frameworks that explicitly account for variability, uncertainty, and alternative explanations.
articles.titleCn: 声纹谬误：为什么声音并非独特的生物特征印记
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，“声纹”一词重新引起关注，尤其在技术应用和政策制定领域，常带有这样一种假设：一个人的声音构成了一种稳定且独特的生物特征痕迹，类似于指纹。然而，自其提出以来，这种观念在数十年来一直遭到法医语音专家的反复批评和否定。尽管声音无疑包含与说话者相关的信息，但这种简化的观念掩盖了言语的高度动态性和依赖语境的性质。本文重新审视了声纹谬误，并通过回顾声纹识别的历史发展、人类声音变异性的证据、法医语音比较的发展、人类和自动说话人识别的研究，以及深度伪造语音对说话人身份提出的最新挑战，重新思考何种证据可以被视为说话人身份的证据。我们指出，声纹隐喻及其潜在含义在科学上是误导性的，因为它们将说话人信息的概率来源转化为一种想象的稳定身份对象。为了避免将声音视为类似印痕的痕迹，我们建议通过经过验证和校准的概率框架来解释语音证据，该框架明确考虑了变异、不确定性和替代解释。

articles.title: Thinking Hard, Not Smart: Reasoning Models Fail to Ration Test-Time Compute Across Questions
articles.abstract: Reasoning language models increasingly use test-time compute to improve performance, but existing evaluations typically study this compute one question at a time. Yet when multiple problems share an end-to-end cost or latency constraint, models must decide how to divide limited inference compute among them. We introduce an exam-style evaluation framework for studying this setting, in which a model must distribute one shared token budget across questions with different difficulty and point values to maximize its total score. Across several open and frontier reasoning models, we find that models fail to allocate a shared budget strategically across questions of varying difficulties and values. Models behave largely as greedy sequential solvers: they prioritize questions by presentation order, front-load effort on early questions, and remain insensitive to value, with these tendencies becoming more pronounced as the number of questions grows. Explicit planning prompts spread compute more evenly but do not produce value- or difficulty-aware prioritization. The same behavioral pattern extends from mathematical to code reasoning. These findings establish global budget allocation as a distinct capability that is not captured by conventional per-question evaluation and remains a challenge for current reasoning models.
articles.titleCn: 深思熟虑，而非聪明：推理模型未能合理分配测试时的计算资源于不同问题
articles.abstractCn: 推理语言模型越来越多地利用测试时的计算资源来提升性能，但现有的评估通常是一次一个问题地研究这种计算资源。然而，当多个问题共享端到端的成本或延迟限制时，模型必须决定如何将有限的推理计算资源分配给它们。我们引入了一种考试式评估框架来研究这种场景，其中模型必须将一个共享的token预算分配到难度和分值不同的问题上，以最大化其总分。在多个开放和前沿推理模型中，我们发现模型无法在难度和分值不同的问题之间策略性地分配共享预算。模型的行为很大程度上像贪婪的顺序求解器：它们按呈现顺序优先处理问题，在早期问题上集中投入精力，并且对分值不敏感，随着问题数量的增加，这些倾向变得更加明显。显式规划提示可以更均匀地分配计算资源，但并不能产生基于分值或难度的优先排序。相同的行为模式从数学推理扩展到了代码推理。这些发现表明，全局预算分配是一项独特的技能，它无法通过传统的逐问题评估来捕捉，并且仍然是当前推理模型面临的挑战。

articles.title: EvoTrustRAG: Evolution-Aware Conflict Attribution and Evidence Handling for Reliable Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models with external knowledge, yet conflicting evidence remains a fundamental challenge in dynamic and adversarial environments. Existing approaches often treat conflicts as static inconsistencies and select more reliable knowledge, overlooking that the same conflict may arise from legitimate knowledge evolution, malicious manipulation, or unresolved uncertainty. We formulate conflict origin attribution as a new problem in RAG: identifying which explanation of conflicting evidence is supported by observable context rather than simply which fact should be trusted. We propose EvoTrustRAG, a training-free framework for evolution-aware conflict attribution and evidence handling before answer generation. EvoTrustRAG represents span-grounded retrieved facts as a conflict evidence graph, evaluates grounded evolution and directional intervention hypotheses using temporal relations, support structure, and auxiliary consistency, and projects local decisions onto a globally consistent explanation of each conflict group. The attribution determines whether earlier and later states are preserved as temporal knowledge, an intervention candidate is separated from the primary context, or an unresolved conflict remains visible to the generator. Unlike provenance-based approaches focused on post-hoc analysis, EvoTrustRAG determines during inference whether conflicting evidence follows plausible knowledge evolution, exhibits intervention-like support, or cannot be reliably attributed. Experiments show that EvoTrustRAG achieves 81.4% average accuracy on benchmark-native conflict settings, improves attribution macro-F1 from 72.2% to 79.1% over the strongest baseline, and reduces the error rate under the strongest coordinated attack from 31.2% to 16.0%.
articles.titleCn: EvoTrustRAG：具有进化感知的冲突归因和证据处理，以实现可靠的检索增强生成
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过外部知识提升了大语言模型的准确性，但在动态和对抗性环境中，冲突证据仍然是一个基本挑战。现有方法通常将冲突视为静态的不一致性，并选择更可靠的知识，而忽略了同样的冲突可能源于合法的知识演变、恶意操纵或未解决的模糊性。我们将冲突来源归因问题作为RAG中的一个新问题提出：识别哪些冲突证据的解释是由可观察的上下文支持的，而不仅仅是应该信任哪个事实。我们提出了EvoTrustRAG，这是一个在生成答案前进行进化感知冲突归因和证据处理的训练无关框架。EvoTrustRAG将检索到的基于片段的事实表示为冲突证据图，使用时间关系、支持结构和辅助一致性来评估基于片段的演变和定向干预假设，并将局部决策投影到每个冲突组的全局一致解释上。归因过程确定早期和后期状态是否作为时间知识保留，干预候选是否与主要上下文分离，或未解决的冲突是否对生成器可见。与基于来源的方法不同，这些方法专注于事后分析，EvoTrustRAG在推理过程中确定冲突证据是否遵循合理的知识演变，是否表现出干预式的支持，或无法可靠地归因。实验表明，EvoTrustRAG在基准原生冲突设置上平均准确率达到81.4%，将归因宏观F1从72.2%提升到79.1%，并将最强协同攻击下的错误率从31.2%降低到16.0%。

articles.title: Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention
articles.abstract: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we identify five recurring patterns: spectral outliers encode a dominant component of the learned structure; Q projections carry the most outliers; V projections under grouped-query attention lack a clean signal/noise separation; entry-level outliers form structured row-bands in Q and column-bands in O; and specific residual-stream dimensions persist as band outliers across layers in K and O. We close by outlining how these observations could inform parameter-efficient fine-tuning and structured pruning.

articles.titleCn: 频谱异常揭示Transformer注意力中的主导学习结构
articles.abstractCn: 我们应用马琴科-帕图尔（MP）随机矩阵理论来分析预训练的注意力权重，以将每个投影矩阵分解为一个随机性的主体部分和一组谱异常值。我们通过因果验证这一分解：将MP识别出的异常值（信号）置零后，Mistral-7B模型在HellaSwag、MMLU和PIQA任务上的表现接近随机水平，而将数量匹配的主体奇异值子集置零则导致更小但不可忽略的性能下降。在11个预训练Transformer模型中，我们识别出五种反复出现的模式：谱异常值编码了学习结构的主要成分；Q投影包含最多的异常值；V投影在分组查询注意力下缺乏清晰的信号/噪声分离；入门级异常值在Q中形成结构化行带，在O中形成列带；特定残差流维度在K和O的各层中持续作为带状异常值存在。最后，我们概述了这些观察结果如何为参数高效的微调和结构化剪枝提供启示。

articles.title: Detection of Self-Introductions in Legislative Testimony
articles.abstract: Self-introductions are common in legislative committee testimonies. Successfully detecting them and extracting the speaker's name is enormously helpful in the task of speaker identification in the context of government meetings. In this paper, we present a pipeline for detection of self-introductions in legislative committee testimony using machine learning. We construct a training dataset from 1.54 million utterances spanning five state legislative sessions, apply a name-matching heuristic to generate automatic labels, and train three classifiers: a decision tree, random forest, and XGBoost to find self-introductions and extract the speaker's name. We construct a feature set combining bag-of-words, positional context, structural signals, introductory phrase indicators, and discourse context features. Among the three classifiers, XGBoost achieves the best performance with an F1 score of 0.9747 and the fewest total errors; adding fine-tuned BERT probability features improves this further. As an extension, we score the full candidate dataset with a fine-tuned BERT classifier and add BERT probability outputs as features. This BERT-augmented XGBoost model improves F1 from 0.9747 to 0.9782 and reduces total test errors from 241 to 207. The primary gain over the decision tree baseline (F1 0.9323) is driven by discourse context features and the boosting ensemble strategy; BERT provides a modest complementary signal. Analysis of false positives reveals that a minority are genuine self-introductions mislabeled due to name inconsistencies in the source data, indicating that measured metrics modestly understate true performance.

articles.titleCn: 立法证词中自我介绍的检测
articles.abstractCn: 在立法委员会证词中，自我介绍很常见。成功检测并提取发言人姓名对于政府会议中的发言人识别任务非常有帮助。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于机器学习的立法委员会证词自我介绍检测流程。我们从跨越五个州立法会议的154万条话语中构建了一个训练数据集，应用名称匹配启发式方法生成自动标签，并训练了三种分类器：决策树、随机森林和XGBoost，以检测自我介绍并提取发言人姓名。我们构建了一个特征集，结合了词袋模型、位置上下文、结构信号、引言短语指示符和话语上下文特征。在三种分类器中，XGBoost表现最佳，F1分数达到0.9747，总错误最少；添加微调BERT概率特征后，性能进一步提升。作为扩展，我们使用微调的BERT分类器对完整候选数据集进行评分，并将BERT概率输出作为特征添加。增强的BERT-XGBoost模型将F1分数从0.9747提升至0.9782，将总测试错误从241减少到207。相较于决策树基线（F1 0.9323），主要提升来自于话语上下文特征和提升集成策略；BERT提供了适度的补充信号。对假阳性的分析表明，其中少数是因源数据中的名称不一致而被误标记的真实自我介绍，这表明测量指标略微低估了实际性能。

articles.title: Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence
articles.abstract: Vision-language grounding connects language to visual content, yet most existing formulations reduce grounding to a unidirectional localization problem: given a prespecified text phrase or category name, identify the corresponding image region. This setup assumes that the relevant linguistic unit is already known, overlooking a more basic challenge in grounded communication: determining which parts of the text are visually referential and how they correspond to entities in the image. We formulate grounding as $\textit{bidirectional concept correspondence}$ over an image-text pair. Given an image and its paired text, the goal is to recover all correspondences between visually referential text spans and instance-level image segments, without assuming that the relevant text spans are provided. This formulation unifies common grounding tasks, including phrase grounding, referring expression grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, by treating text segmentation, image segmentation, and cross-modal alignment as a single correspondence prediction problem. To address this task, we introduce $\textbf{ConCor-1}$, a grounding model built on top of a pretrained vision-language model. It uses learnable $\textit{bridge tokens}$ to represent candidate image-text correspondences and predicts, for each token, a text mask, an image mask, and a correspondence presence score. To train and evaluate this task, we convert diverse grounding and segmentation datasets into a unified correspondence format. Experiments show that $\textbf{ConCor-1}$ consistently outperforms baselines, improving correspondence F1 by 48% on the long-caption dataset and by 29% on zero-shot LVIS, where the large category list serves as the text input.
articles.titleCn: 视觉-语言 grounding 作为双向概念对应
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言 grounding 技术将语言与视觉内容相连接，然而现有的大多数方法将 grounding 简化为一个单向定位问题：给定一个预设的文本短语或类别名称，识别相应的图像区域。这种设定假设相关的语言单元已经知晓，而忽略了 grounding 通信中一个更基本的问题：确定文本中哪些部分具有视觉指称性，以及它们如何对应图像中的实体。我们将 grounding 定义为图像-文本对之间的 $\textit{双向概念对应}$。给定图像及其配对的文本，目标是恢复所有具有视觉指称性的文本片段与实例级图像片段之间的对应关系，而无需预先提供相关的文本片段。这种定义方式将常见的 grounding 任务统一了起来，包括短语 grounding、指代表达 grounding 和开放词汇检测，通过将文本分割、图像分割和跨模态对齐视为一个单一的对应预测问题。为了解决这一任务，我们引入了 $\textbf{ConCor-1}$，这是一个基于预训练视觉-语言模型的 grounding 模型。它使用可学习的 $\textit{桥梁标记}$ 来表示候选的图像-文本对应关系，并为每个标记预测一个文本掩码、一个图像掩码和一个对应存在分数。为了训练和评估这一任务，我们将多种 grounding 和分割数据集转换为统一的对应格式。实验表明，$\textbf{ConCor-1}$ 始终优于基线模型，在 long-caption 数据集上对应 F1 提高了 48%，在 zero-shot LVIS 上提高了 29%，其中大型类别列表作为文本输入。

articles.title: GRACE: LLM-Grounded Semantic Metric Spaces for Scalable Mixed-Data Clustering
articles.abstract: Clustering mixed tabular data requires a unified metric space to bridge the inherent heterogeneity between continuous numerical measurements and discrete categorical symbols. Traditionally, algorithms rely entirely on dataset-internal statistics to estimate categorical relationships, which confines the learned metric to empirical co-occurrences and ignores conceptually obvious yet statistically unobserved affinities. Although LLMs offer external world knowledge, applying their text-centric reasoning to highly abstract tabular concepts presents significant challenges. Bridging this modality gap to construct a semantically complete metric typically requires embedding LLMs into iterative metric learning loops to dynamically optimize cross-modality representations. This incurs intractable computational overhead, forcing a compromise between semantic enrichment and scalability. Therefore, we propose GRACE, an LLM-grounded framework for scalable mixed-data clustering. GRACE shifts semantic acquisition to the attribute-value level via a multi-perspective LLM querying strategy, mapping heterogeneous values into knowledge-informed descriptions. Crucially, this one-shot grounding extracts general-purpose semantic representations that embed heterogeneous attributes into a unified space, decoupling expensive LLM invocation from iterative optimization. Furthermore, GRACE cross-validates these external semantics against dataset-internal statistical evidence to ensure alignment with the dataset-specific cluster structure. Ultimately, GRACE matches the scalability of conventional statistics-driven baselines while achieving superior clustering accuracy and conceptual interpretability over 11 competing methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/develop-yang/GRACE-GRACE-A
articles.titleCn: GRACE：基于大型语言模型的地标语义度量空间，用于可扩展的混合数据聚类
articles.abstractCn: 对混合表格数据进行聚类需要构建一个统一的度量空间，以弥合连续数值测量与离散类别符号之间固有的异质性。传统算法完全依赖数据集内部的统计信息来估计类别关系，这使得学习到的度量仅限于经验共现，而忽略了概念上明显但在统计上未被观察到的亲和力。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了外部世界知识，但将其以文本为中心的推理应用于高度抽象的表格概念面临着重大挑战。弥合这种模态差距以构建语义完整的度量通常需要将LLMs嵌入到迭代度量学习循环中，以动态优化跨模态表示。这导致了难以处理的计算开销，迫使人们在语义丰富性和可扩展性之间做出权衡。因此，我们提出了GRACE，这是一个基于LLMs的可扩展混合数据聚类框架。GRACE通过多视角LLM查询策略将语义获取转移到属性值级别，将异构值映射到知识引导的描述。关键在于，这种单次锚定提取了通用的语义表示，将异构属性嵌入到一个统一的空间中，将昂贵的LLM调用与迭代优化解耦。此外，GRACE将这些外部语义与数据集内部的统计证据进行交叉验证，以确保与数据集特定的聚类结构保持一致。最终，GRACE在可扩展性上与传统的统计驱动基线相匹配，同时在聚类精度和概念可解释性上优于11种竞争方法。源代码可在https://github.com/develop-yang/GRACE-GRACE-A获取。

articles.title: SurakshaEval: An Indic Safety Benchmark for Multilingual LLMs
articles.abstract: Existing safety evaluation datasets for large language models (LLMs) predominantly focus on English and Western contexts, often overlooking the linguistic diversity and culturally grounded safety risks present in other languages. To address this gap, we introduce SurakshaEval, a novel safety benchmark composed of human-written prompts spanning real-world scenarios, explicitly designed for ten major Indian languages - Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu, along with English. SurakshaEval includes both generic prompts common across India and region- and language-specific prompts that capture localized sociocultural sensitivities. We benchmark a broad range of state-of-the-art LLMs on SurakshaEval, establish baseline safety performance, and identify recurring failure modes, including over-refusal, missed detection of implicit bias, and insufficient contextual awareness in regionally sensitive settings. Our results show that even strong multilingual LLMs struggle to reliably meet nuanced safety requirements when operating in Indic languages, particularly in native scripts. These findings highlight the urgent need for safety evaluation frameworks that incorporate region-specific data and structured assessment protocols, enabling the development and deployment of AI systems that operate securely, ethically, and in alignment with diverse societal values. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/SurakshaEval. Warning: This paper contains text that may be offensive or unsafe.
articles.titleCn: SurakshaEval：一个面向多语言LLM的印度语安全基准
articles.abstractCn: 现有的用于大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全评估数据集主要集中于英语和西方环境，往往忽略了其他语言中存在的语言多样性和文化相关安全风险。为填补这一空白，我们引入了SurakshaEval，这是一个新颖的安全基准，包含针对现实场景的人类编写的提示，专门为十种主要的印度语言——阿萨姆语、孟加拉语、古吉拉特语、印地语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语，以及英语设计。SurakshaEval既包括在印度普遍通用的通用提示，也包括捕捉地方社会文化敏感性的区域和语言特定提示。我们在SurakshaEval上对一系列最先进的LLMs进行了基准测试，建立了安全性能基线，并识别出反复出现的失效模式，包括过度拒绝、未能检测到隐含偏见以及在区域敏感环境中缺乏足够的语境意识。我们的结果表明，即使是强大的多语言LLMs在处理印度语言时，尤其是在使用本地文字时，也难以可靠地满足细致的安全要求。这些发现突显了建立包含区域特定数据和结构化评估协议的安全评估框架的紧迫性，以促进开发并部署在安全、合乎道德且符合多元社会价值观的AI系统。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/debobanerjee/SurakshaEval获取。警告：本文包含可能具有冒犯性或不安全的内容。

articles.title: "Many Are My Names": The Anatomy of the Assistant and Its Personas via Sparse Autoencoders
articles.abstract: How a language model internally represents who is speaking, the Assistant, an assigned roleplay persona, or a narrated story character, remains underexplored. We study speaker representations using a dataset of user-expressed emotional text and corresponding model responses. We decompose three generation settings (Assistant, Roleplay, and Story) into sparse autoencoder features extracted at turn-boundary and pronoun-token positions and selected through a filtering pipeline for different depths. We characterize each surviving feature through its steering effects and activation distribution. Our main finding is that the Assistant and roleplay personas are not independent alternatives: personas retain the Assistant-associated feature core while progressively differentiating from it across layers, starting from operational machinery towards behavioral and stylistic features. Meanwhile, generated story characters lack the Assistant-associated core. Both Story and Roleplay can be distinguished from the Assistant with Immersive Simulation Mode. However, the Assistant can sometimes enter or slowly drift into it even in the default setting.
articles.titleCn: 《吾之名众多》：稀疏自动编码器解析助手及其角色模型
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在内部如何表征说话者——是助手、分配的角色扮演者还是叙述故事的角色——这一领域仍待深入探索。我们利用用户表达的文本情感数据集及其对应的模型响应来研究说话者表征。我们将三种生成设置（助手、角色扮演和故事）分解为在回合边界和代词标记位置提取的稀疏自动编码器特征，并通过过滤管道在不同深度进行选择。我们通过每个幸存特征的方向效应和激活分布来刻画其特征。我们的主要发现是，助手和角色扮演者并非相互独立的替代方案：角色保留着与助手相关的特征核心，同时在各层中逐步与其分化，从操作机制到行为和风格特征。与此同时，生成的故事角色缺乏与助手相关的核心。故事和角色扮演都可以通过沉浸式模拟模式与助手区分开来。然而，即使在默认设置下，助手有时也会进入或逐渐漂移到该模式中。

articles.title: TEMPER: Tensorized Efficient Manifold-constrained Parameterization for Expressive Residual Routing
articles.abstract: Residual connections rely on a static residual pathway, and are essential for training deep neural networks. Hyper-connections (HC) increase the expressivity of residual routing by incorporating multiple residual streams and learning dynamic information flow, while manifold-constrained (mHC) variants stabilize training through doubly stochastic residual mixing. However, a generator-level bottleneck remains in existing methods: they use dense, unstructured generators for pre-branch aggregation, residual mixing, and post-branch redistribution, which results in parameter count growing rapidly with the number of streams. To address this issue, we propose \underline{\textbf{T}}ensorized \underline{\textbf{E}}fficient \underline{\textbf{M}}anifold-constrained \underline{\textbf{P}}arameterization for \underline{\textbf{E}}xpressive Residual \underline{\textbf{R}}outing (\textbf{TEMPER}), which represents these generators as multi-way tensors over the input-stream, feature, and output-stream modes, and parameterizes them using tensor networks. Such a structured low-rank formulation is shown to preserve token-dependent manifold-constrained routing interface while substantially reducing parameter growth. It also promotes interpretability and intuition, as: i) tensor ranks control the dimensionality of the learned routing subspace, with full ranks recovering dense routing; while ii) the generator approximation errors bound differences in routing logits and, consequently, in the routed-block outputs. Comprehensive experiments show that TEMPER matches or outperforms existing methods across language modeling and commonsense reasoning tasks, while requiring substantially fewer additional parameters. At eight residual streams, TEMPER achieves the best CORE score while using about $84\%$ fewer additional parameters than mHC, thus showing a stronger performance-parameter efficiency trade-off.
articles.titleCn: TEMPER：一种用于表达性残差路由的张量化高效流形约束参数化方法
articles.abstractCn: 残差连接依赖于静态残差通路，对于训练深度神经网络至关重要。超连接（HC）通过整合多个残差流并学习动态信息流，提高了残差路由的表达能力，而流形约束（mHC）变体则通过双重随机残差混合稳定训练。然而，现有方法中仍然存在一个生成器层面的瓶颈：它们使用密集、非结构的生成器进行预分支聚合、残差混合和后分支重新分配，导致参数数量随着流数量的增加而迅速增长。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了用于表达性残差路由的Tensorized Efficient Manifold-constrained Parameterization（TEMPER），它将这些生成器表示为跨越输入流、特征和输出流模式的 多路张量，并使用张量网络对其进行参数化。这种结构化的低秩公式被证明在保留标记依赖的流形约束路由接口的同时，大幅减少了参数增长。它还提高了可解释性和直观性，因为：i) 张量秩控制了学习路由子空间的维度，满秩则恢复密集路由；ii) 生成器近似误差界定了路由logits的差异，进而界定了路由模块输出的差异。综合实验表明，TEMPER在语言建模和常识推理任务上与现有方法相当或表现更优，同时所需的额外参数大幅减少。在八个残差流的情况下，TEMPER实现了最佳的CORE分数，同时比mHC少使用约84%的额外参数，从而展现出更强的性能-参数效率权衡。

articles.title: From token probabilities to calibrated confidence: An empirical study of mathematical question answering
articles.abstract: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) aims to estimate the probability that a generated answer is correct, while calibration aligns these estimates with empirical accuracy. Prior work has shown that token probabilities are often overconfident, we investigate whether these readily available signals can nevertheless provide well-calibrated confidence estimation for mathematical question answering. We compare single-pass estimators, which reuse token probabilities from the original generation, with multi-pass estimators, which obtain additional confidence signals through verification or stochastic forward passes. While individual token probabilities can be highly saturated, we find that aggregating token probabilities over the full sequence captures small but consistent differences between correct and incorrect generations, yielding more informative confidence estimates. Multi-pass methods can yield calibrated confidence estimates. We study two such approaches: self-verification through re-prompting, including a lower-cost in-situ variant, and Monte Carlo Dropout, which derives confidence from variation across stochastic forward passes. We further evaluate two post-hoc calibration methods, Platt scaling and isotonic regression, both of which substantially reduce in-domain calibration error. However, their data efficiency varies with dataset difficulty, and the calibration mappings often transfer asymmetrically across datasets and models.
articles.titleCn: 从token概率到校准置信度：数学问题回答的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的置信度估计旨在评估生成答案正确的概率，而校准则是将这些估计与经验准确度进行对齐。已有研究表明，标记概率往往过于自信，我们探究这些现成的信号是否仍然能为数学问题回答提供良好校准的置信度估计。我们将单次估计器（重用原始生成中的标记概率）与多次估计器（通过验证或随机前向传递获取额外的置信度信号）进行比较。虽然单个标记概率可能高度饱和，我们发现通过在整个序列上聚合标记概率能够捕捉到正确与错误生成之间微小但一致的差异，从而产生更具信息的置信度估计。多次估计方法可以产生校准后的置信度估计。我们研究了两种此类方法：通过重新提示进行自验证（包括一种低成本的原位变体）以及蒙特卡洛Dropout（从随机前向传递中的变化中推导置信度）。我们进一步评估了两种后处理校准方法：Platt缩放和等变回归，这两种方法都显著降低了领域内校准误差。然而，它们的计算效率随数据集难度而变化，校准映射往往在不同数据集和模型之间呈非对称传递。
